_meta.note: Re-verify every phone number and URL before any public deployment. Immigration resources are safety-critical — verify quarterly.
_meta.privacy: Maximum privacy mode applies to this domain — see PRIVACY_POLICY.md

organizations.name: United We Dream — MigraWatch Hotline
organizations.eligibility: Anyone — report ICE activity or get rapid-response help
organizations.what_they_help_with: 24/7 hotline to report immigration enforcement, get connected to local rapid-response networks, and know-your-rights support.

organizations.name: RAICES
organizations.eligibility: Immigrants and families, especially detained people; free and low-cost
organizations.what_they_help_with: Free and low-cost legal services for immigrants — detention, asylum, family reunification, bond assistance.

organizations.name: National Immigration Law Center
organizations.eligibility: Policy and know-your-rights hub; refers to direct services
organizations.what_they_help_with: Know-your-rights materials in multiple languages; defends access to healthcare, benefits, and workplaces regardless of status.

organizations.name: Immigration Advocates Network — Legal Directory
organizations.what_they_help_with: Searchable directory of over 1,000 free and low-cost nonprofit immigration legal services providers, by state and county.

organizations.name: ICE Online Detainee Locator
organizations.eligibility: Anyone searching for a detained adult
organizations.what_they_help_with: Find where someone is being held in ICE detention (needs their A-number or exact name and country of birth). Use with an attorney's guidance.

organizations.name: EOIR Immigration Court Information Line
organizations.eligibility: Anyone with a pending immigration court case (A-number required)
organizations.what_they_help_with: Automated system for hearing dates and case status in immigration court, in English and Spanish.
